probe_1_reversing.vulnerability: Vehicle can reverse into negative speed (MIN_SPEED = -40 m/s); receives 0 speed reward, but avoids all downstream forward traffic.

probe_2_parking.vulnerability: Vehicle incurs zero headway penalty at v=0 (if empty ahead) and avoids all collision risk with zero control effort.

probe_3_straddle.vulnerability: Discrete TacticalOvertakingWrapper relies strictly on ego.lane_index; an obstacle in an adjacent lane directly in ego path is ignored if ego lane index doesn't match.

probe_4_offroad_grazing.vulnerability: offroad_terminal is False in default highway-fast-v0; ego can drive in the grass indefinitely without episode termination unless it hits a vehicle.

probe_5_dwell_flicker.finding: Overtake dwell correctly resets to 0 when vehicle position flips; no false credit awarded for 4-step flicker.

probe_6_tailgating_at_hmin.finding: Sharp step boundary at headway_min=1.0s: tailgating at 1.001s receives 0.0 penalty despite zero reaction buffer under discrete 0.2s control steps.

probe_7_speed_matching_zero_ttc.finding: Because TTC is closing-only (v_rel > 0), an agent tailgating at only 2 meters receives reward_ttc = 0.0 by matching speed with lead vehicle (partially mitigated by headway penalty).

probe_8_provoking_slowdowns.finding: Ego cutting into lane immediately slows trailing vehicle. However, each vehicle can only be credited ONCE per episode due to credited_overtakes set, eliminating repetitive farming on the same vehicle.

probe_9_steady_high_yaw.vulnerability: Reward function lacks an explicit heading error penalty (R_heading); holding extreme steering angle steadily incurs zero jerk and zero control penalty!

probe_10_end_of_horizon.mechanism: Absence of truncation bootstrapping in PPO (B7)
probe_10_end_of_horizon.finding: Because truncations are treated as terminal (dones=1), V(s_500)=0. Near the horizon, policy has no incentive to maintain heading/lane stability beyond step 500.

probe_11_clip_saturation.finding: Both control penalty and jerk penalty are clipped cleanly to [-1.0, 0.0], preventing gradient explosions during sudden bang-bang saturation.

probe_12_evaluation_circularity.mechanism: info['overtake_count'] derived from wrapper internal state
probe_12_evaluation_circularity.finding: Evaluation scripts read info['overtake_count'] directly from the environment wrapper rather than an independent metric recorder; any counting glitch in the wrapper is faithfully mirrored into benchmark logs.

probe_13_trailing_traffic_blindness.vulnerability: Reward function only monitors lead obstacles (dx > 0); fast-approaching trailing vehicles closing in from behind produce zero warning penalty.

probe_14_offroad_no_crash.finding: Driving off the road into open space does not set crashed=True; unless offroad_terminal is explicitly set, the episode continues.

probe_15_two_step_jitter.finding: 2-step holding cuts discrete jitter penalty by 50% while still achieving effective PWM speed regulation.
